hypothesis: Real-dose scratch run, first serious attempt since the nodes5000pv2-only scratch disaster (1 epoch/4578 superbatches, elo=-460, proven undertrained not a bad-source signal - loss converged normally and residual corr to rc10 was 0.96, so the net fit the average value fine but never learned the local position-to-position consistency search depends on). This combines the two largest available corpora for real volume and diversity - lc0-static.bullet (11,955,404 positions, Lc0 test91 self-play with its own Q-value/policy fully discarded, only FEN survives, relabeled with a genuine zero-search Enyo+SF-net static eval) concatenated with nodes5000pv2-recalibrated-2b.bullet (2,000,000,000 positions, magnitude-recalibrated Stockfish search labels) for 2,011,955,404 total positions. Scratch: no continue_from, full lr schedule (0.001->0.000005) instead of a fine-tune polish rate, trainable all, wdl 0.05. Dose: 5 epochs (76762 superbatches), matching the order of magnitude of the historical scratch-long/sb32768 precedent but over more and more diverse data than that run used, and enough to actually learn position-to-position consistency rather than just the average value. Gated against enyo-1.32.0-rc10 same as any other candidate; if promising, a further round continuing from this run's own output is the natural next step, matching how scratch-long itself progressed over multiple rounds.
